Icons that know
what they are for.

Drawn from scratch on a 24 grid — nothing traced, nothing re-licensed. Five weights and six animations generated from one geometry, so bold can never drift away from line. Take any icon at any size, in any colour, as SVG, PNG or JPG.

Take it three ways

All three are the same geometry. Pick whichever suits the project — nothing here needs a build step.

The sprite

One request for the whole set, then reference an icon by name. Both files are served from icons.imswarnil.com.

<link rel="stylesheet"
      href="…/swarnil-icons.css">

<svg class="ic ic-lg">
  <use href="…/sprite.svg#i-camera"/>
</svg>

The package

The source SVGs, the sprite, the JSON index and both stylesheets.

npm i @imswarnil/swarnil-icons

import icons from
  '@imswarnil/swarnil-icons'
// …/css   …/motion   …/sprite

Colour and motion

Colour reads your design system's --accent if you have one, and falls back to ours if you do not.

ic-primary              brand colour
ic-solid ic-primary     filled with it
ic-multi ic-multi-fill  three colours
ic-scan ic-tv-loop      a screen

Swarnil Icons

Drawn from scratch on a 24 grid. The rules are in STYLE.md and enforced by validate.py.
